notes.title: Patch v1057
notes.notes:
Starting experience update
[list]
  [*][b]Increased first level bonus for ~20 features.[/b] Like Jump hole generator starts on sector 80. 
  [*][b]Autobuy has 1/5 levels per purchase opened by default [/b] (was 1 only)
  [*]Spawn enemies mostly on screen
  [*]Reworked starting money mechanic and updated stat description

  [*]Beam platform can be hidden too now (not just laser)
  [*]Fix gambler scaling
  [*]Crit chance and crit damage stats on stats page
[/list]

P.S. I don't post every small fix\update here. You can always see what was changed by small 1mb update ingame (click on label [b]"rev XXXX"[/b] right to sector controls in top middle)
